en: Vintage divided-image postcard showing the interior and exterior of a grand café with vaulted ceilings and bistro tables. The exterior view depicts a corner building with the sign of Café Europa and people standing in front. Handwritten German script covers much of the front. The back has address fields, a postage stamp with a Marburg postmark, and a purple library stamp.
